scope: Current tracked repository, independent baseline and architecture review, focused source-binding investigation and parent validation.

findings.fix: Use immutable base/head comparison with terminal-head validation and SHA-pinned directory membership; selected files must match regular-file modes and blob IDs. Final PR freshness checks remain.
regressions: Head changes and returns cannot substitute safe source.
Incomplete or substituted comparison/tree evidence, symlinks and submodules reject before scanning.
Merge-base evidence is separate from live base identity; renames, deletions and mixed scope remain supported.

findings.fix: Validate origin-form request targets and parse URLs inside the HTTP error boundary.
regressions: Raw malformed request targets return a bounded error.
Subsequent normal sample and asset requests still succeed.
Existing Origin, not-found and invalid-JSON responses remain intact.

local_verification.browser: passed on isolated loopback port 18181 because 8080 was in use

native_scanner_acceptance.github_api: controlled contract responses; not a live GitHub source-binding acceptance

findings.message: User-controlled input reaches eval. Replace dynamic evaluation with a strict parser.
User-controlled input reaches eval. Replace dynamic evaluation with a strict parser.

limits: Automatic comparisons accept at most 299 changed files to reject the provider's 300-file truncation boundary.
Selected directory responses must be untruncated and at most 4 MiB; at most 1,000 API reads and a five-minute read deadline.
Fork object reads depend on scoped base-repository access and fail closed when inaccessible.
Narrow direct eval(input(...)) policy remains explicit; this is not complete vulnerability coverage.
No live racing exploit or production branch-protection claim. Historical signed App acceptance is separately recorded in github-app-verification.json.
hosted_ci: Verify workflow badge and current Actions run identify the final published commit.
hosted_ci_dependency_fix: The first hosted attempt timed out retrieving Ubuntu package metadata from the runner HTTP mirror. Verification uses the official HTTPS archive mirror, bounded APT network timeouts and a five-minute browser-install step limit. Package signature verification remains enabled.
